name: Victory
overview: Scripture reveals that true victory comes from the Lord who fights on behalf of His people, assuring them not to fear overwhelming odds because God is with them and will save them (Deuteronomy 20:1,4). Believers are encouraged to rise again after setbacks, reflecting the perseverance of the righteous (Proverbs 24:16). Christ’s overcoming of the world grants His followers peace amid tribulation, empowering them to be of good courage (John 16:33). Additionally, the Holy Spirit serves as a Comforter and teacher, reminding believers of Christ’s words and sustaining them in their victorious walk (John 14:26).
